candidates.rationale: The failing tasks (e003, e005, e008, e019) all involve commands that are on the allowlist but access files outside the /work directory. The model is currently treating the policy as command-only. By explicitly stating that the sandbox restricts file access to the workspace root, the model will correctly DENY these path-escaping commands.
candidates.root_cause: P1: The model fails to recognize that 'sandboxed' implies a strict filesystem boundary (workspace root) in addition to the command allowlist, leading it to ALLOW commands accessing paths outside /work (e.g., /etc/hosts, /tmp/x).
candidates.what: Explicitly define the security policy to include both command allowlisting AND strict path confinement to the workspace root, and instruct the model to resolve all paths (including relative and symlinked) to check if they escape the workspace.
